postprocessing.command_shape: strip metadata, resize only if wider than 1440 pixels, encode WebP at quality 84

prompt_spec: Visualize a finite horizon-indexed Q table as a stack of translucent glass data slabs.
Every slab is a precise rectangular grid of state-action cells.
A single luminous decision path moves through one cell on successive slabs and ends at a terminal slab.
Use a clean warm-white background, crisp vector-like geometry, navy, cyan, violet, and amber.
No text, letters, digits, formulas, legends, people, robots, brains, logos, or watermarks.
Compare two representations in a balanced two-panel illustration.
On the left, show a literal lookup table as a precise grid of independent addressable cells with one coordinate selecting exactly one cell.
On the right, show a compact shared-feature model whose reusable feature prisms connect to many state-action tiles and combine at one output.
Use a clean warm-white background, crisp vector-like geometry, navy, cyan, violet, teal, and amber.
No text, letters, digits, formulas, legends, people, robots, brains, logos, or watermarks.

note: Generated illustrations communicate visual structure. Exact logical branches and arithmetic use code-native SVG and MathJax.
